title: Catch-all session node: inline chat tokens enter cost-flow attribution
summary: Approved design (2026-06-10): main-session tokens not attributed to any task get a per-session catch-all node — own_tokens = session total minus task splits, context edges to every task/note that session created. Conversation tokens thus become productive only if the work they steered reaches a merged result ("research needs a result" applied to chat itself); sessions producing nothing trap their tokens as named waste. Also makes the session node the canonical token owner, complementing the claim-window splits in lib/costflow.js. Refinement: escalation-gate hook when a session catch-all exceeds ~1M tokens with zero outgoing edges (burning tokens, producing nothing graph-visible — either real waste or a missing task). Rejected alternative: per-request task nodes (graph noise; DAG already hard to read at 343 nodes). Builds on note-mq87hnkfo3w / note-mq875f7iit6.
